author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

As noticed in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51626#issuecomment-5295385788 the `servicesJobReport_t.cpp` was last being run in April 2007. That test was the only need to have the `JobReportService` being defined in the `src` directory instead of `plugins`. This PR removes the test (as not being run in 19 years), and then moves the `JobReportService` to `plugins`.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2393

#### PR validation:

Framework unit tests succeed.
title: Move contents of `FWCore/Services/src` to `FWCore/Services/plugins`
